name: The Yardbirds

whyMatters.en: London R&B band formed in 1963. They replaced the Rolling Stones as Crawdaddy Club residents; lead guitarists were successively Eric Clapton (then Bluesbreakers/Cream), Jeff Beck (distortion experiments later cited by Gilmour and Slash), and Jimmy Page (New Yardbirds → Led Zeppelin).
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦 R&B 乐队，1963 年成立。接替 Rolling Stones 担任 Crawdaddy Club 驻场；主音吉他手依次为 Eric Clapton（后去 Bluesbreakers／Cream）、Jeff Beck（失真实验后被 Gilmour、Slash 引用）、Jimmy Page（New Yardbirds → Led Zeppelin）。

shortBio.en: London R&B, 1963–68. Guitarists in order: Topham, Clapton, Beck, Page. For Your Love, Heart Full of Soul, Shapes of Things; Page’s post-band dates became Led Zeppelin.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦 R&B，1963–68。吉他手顺序：Topham、Clapton、Beck、Page。代表单曲 For Your Love、Heart Full of Soul、Shapes of Things；Page 解散后场次变为 Led Zeppelin。

body.en:
The Yardbirds formed in London in 1963. In September that year, while the Rolling Stones toured with Bo Diddley, the Yardbirds took over as house band at the Crawdaddy Club in Richmond, Surrey. Keith Relf sang; Paul Samwell-Smith, Chris Dreja, and Jim McCarty completed the early core. Anthony Topham was the first guitarist; 18-year-old Eric Clapton joined the next month.

Columbia signed the band. The blues-standard single Good Morning Little Schoolgirl charted modestly in 1964. For Your Love (May 1965) was a UK/US hit with a more pop arrangement; blues purist Clapton left for John Mayall’s Bluesbreakers (and later Cream). Jeff Beck replaced him for the band’s strongest commercial and creative stretch—Heart Full of Soul, Shapes of Things, Evil Hearted You, and the album Yardbirds (1966; US title Over Under Sideways Down). Beck’s distortion experiments were later cited as influences on Dave Gilmour and Slash.

Jimmy Page joined; the Beck–Page dual-lead lineup often turned live sets into contests. After a failed late-1966 US tour, Beck was fired. Their only dual-lead single was Happenings Ten Years Time Ago. The band broke up in July 1968. Page fulfilled Scandinavian dates as the New Yardbirds; that group became Led Zeppelin. Beck then cut Hi Ho Silver Lining (1967), Beck’s Bolero, and Truth (1968) with the Jeff Beck Group.
body.zh:
The Yardbirds 于 1963 年在伦敦成立。同年 9 月，Rolling Stones 与 Bo Diddley 巡演期间，Yardbirds 接替他们担任萨里里士满 Crawdaddy Club 驻场。Keith Relf 主唱；Paul Samwell-Smith、Chris Dreja、Jim McCarty 构成早期核心。Anthony Topham 是首位吉他手；次月 18 岁的 Eric Clapton 加入。

与哥伦比亚签约后，布鲁斯标准曲单曲 Good Morning Little Schoolgirl 于 1964 年小火。For Your Love（1965 年 5 月）以更偏流行的编曲成为英美热单；布鲁斯纯粹主义者 Clapton 离队加入 John Mayall 的 Bluesbreakers（后去 Cream）。Jeff Beck 接任，迎来商业与创作高峰——Heart Full of Soul、Shapes of Things、Evil Hearted You，以及专辑 Yardbirds（1966；美版名 Over Under Sideways Down）。Beck 的扭曲音实验后被 Dave Gilmour、Slash 引用。

Jimmy Page 加入；Beck–Page 双主音现场常变成两人竞赛。1966 年底美国巡演失利后 Beck 被解雇。双主音时期仅录单曲 Happenings Ten Years Time Ago。乐队 1968 年 7 月解散。Page 以 New Yardbirds 名义完成斯堪的纳维亚合约场次，随后变为 Led Zeppelin。Beck 其后推出 Hi Ho Silver Lining（1967）、Beck’s Bolero，以及与 Jeff Beck Group 的 Truth（1968）。

body.en:
In September 1963, while the Rolling Stones toured with Bo Diddley, the Yardbirds took the Crawdaddy Club residency in Richmond. Anthony Topham was first on guitar; Eric Clapton joined at 18 the next month.

Good Morning Little Schoolgirl (1964) was a modest blues-standard hit. For Your Love (May 1965) moved toward pop and became a UK/US breakthrough. Clapton left for John Mayall’s Bluesbreakers, later Cream.

Good Morning Little Schoolgirl（1964）是布鲁斯标准曲小热。For Your Love（1965 年 5 月）偏流行，成为英美突破。Clapton 离队加入 John Mayall 的 Bluesbreakers，后去 Cream。

body.en:
Beck cut the pop single Hi Ho Silver Lining (1967) and the instrumental Beck’s Bolero. With the Jeff Beck Group he recorded Truth (1968), an early heavy-rock landmark, before that band dissolved.

Later solo work ranged across Memphis soul (Rough and Ready, 1972), jazz-rock (Blow by Blow, 1975), and rockabilly (Crazy Legs, 1993). He entered the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a solo artist in 2009.
body.zh:
Beck 推出流行单曲 Hi Ho Silver Lining（1967）与器乐 Beck’s Bolero。与 Jeff Beck Group 录制 Truth（1968）——早期重型摇滚代表——后该团解散。

此后个人作品跨越 Memphis soul（Rough and Ready，1972）、爵士摇滚（Blow by Blow，1975）与 rockabilly（Crazy Legs，1993）。2009 年以独唱身份入选摇滚名人堂。
